prompts.name: chest
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single production-ready transparent ground pickup sprite for Last Star, a celestial-gothic painterly side-view fantasy action game. Art direction: refined hand-painted high-end fantasy game art, convincing crafted materials, elegant aged gold, silverwood, icy azure star magic; crisp edges and strong simple silhouette, beautiful at 1024 pixels but immediately recognizable at 40–80 pixels. Camera: near-frontal three-quarter object view with very mild top-down visibility. Lighting: consistent soft strong upper-left light, restrained magical highlights. Composition: ONE isolated centered object, longest dimension fills 80–85% of a square canvas, 8–10% clear transparent margin. Background MUST be genuine transparent alpha, all pixels around object fully transparent. No text, labels, border, UI frame, vignette, panel, pedestal, ground slab, surface, background color, checkerboard, environment, loose dust field, cast shadow, or watermark. Fine ornament must support clear broad material shapes. Subject: one CLOSED treasure chest with a beautiful readable horizontal rectangular silhouette, lid visibly shut. Aged warm brass bands and sculpted corner guards frame deep midnight-blue silverwood panels. Slightly rounded lid, bold central eight-point star lock holding a small icy-blue crystal, and very restrained luminous blue seams. Chest front and right side visible; broad front is dominant. Believable wood grain, broad worn brass highlights, a few tasteful celestial etched lines. The chest itself must read at tiny size and feel like a valuable physical treasure container. Longest horizontal dimension 82% of canvas, overall height around 60–66% of canvas. No coins or objects outside chest. No open lid, no protruding weapons, no lettering.

prompts.name: chest-open
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent opened-state sprite for the same Last Star treasure chest. Input image 1 is the exact edit target and identity reference. Change only the chest lid from fully closed to visibly HINGED OPEN. Keep the lower chest box, its front-facing star lock, the front and right side perspective, midnight-blue silverwood panels, aged brass bands and corner guards, blue gems, painterly material treatment, and upper-left light direction as close as possible to the reference. The open lid should hinge backward naturally on rear hinges and rise above the box, showing its inner wood lining. The chest's interior must be clearly DARK and EMPTY, readable as an opened container: no treasure, coins, loot, magical beam, smoke, or objects inside. Subdue the blue seam glow while preserving the small blue star lock's identity. Maintain a coherent three-quarter camera, broad horizontal chest silhouette, straight believable box geometry, and carefully aligned hinge mechanics. Keep the full lower box and the entire raised lid visible without clipping. Center the whole opened chest with ample genuine transparent padding on all sides; object longest dimension about 80–84% of canvas. Genuine alpha transparency outside the object, no background, floor, cast shadow, border, text, checkerboard, pedestal, vignette, or extra objects. Do not alter or redesign the lower chest. Render a single sprite only.
